# pull_request_target that checks out the fork's code.
expect: gha-pr-target-checkout
-- .github/workflows/pr.yml --
name: pr
on:
  pull_request_target:
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  t:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
